name: Websites & Landing Pages
mediaAlt: Website and landing page design preview
desc: Fast, clear sites with messaging, proof and one call to action on every device.
details: Custom websites and landing pages built in Framer, Webflow or WordPress. I design for conversion first — clear hierarchy, strong proof and a single, obvious next step on every screen. Every build is fast, mobile-first and SEO-ready, with analytics wired in from day one.

name: Graphic Design
desc: Brand systems, social assets and visual identity that work across every channel.
details: Logo systems, color palettes, typography and brand guidelines — plus social posts, presentations and marketing collateral. I build a visual system once that scales across web, print and social, so your brand always looks consistent and intentional.

name: Social Media Management
desc: Content strategy, design and scheduling that turns followers into customers.
details: I plan, design and schedule a month of content around your goals — posts, stories, reels and ads. Each asset is designed in your brand system, scheduled to a calendar, and reviewed against performance so your audience grows every month.

name: Automation Tools
desc: Lead capture, follow-ups and workflow automation that save small teams hours.
details: I connect your website, CRM, email and Slack into one system. Forms trigger follow-up sequences, alerts and reporting automatically — so nothing falls through the cracks and your team only handles what needs a human. Built with Claude, MCP and the tools that ship fastest.

name: UI/UX & Dashboards
desc: User flows, wireframes and clickable prototypes, with developer-ready Figma files.
details: I map the user journey, build wireframes for approval, then design high-fidelity screens and interactive prototypes. Every component is named, sized and documented so your developer can build it without guessing. Ideal for web apps, dashboards and admin panels.

name: Website Redesigns
desc: Fix confusing copy and structure so more visitors take the next step.
details: I audit what isn't working, rewrite the messaging and rebuild the site around a single goal. The result is a website that explains your product in seconds and makes the next step obvious — without a full rebuild if it doesn't need one.
